title: A question about art
author: Steemx
selftext:
Hello I'm not a dev or even a computer guy but I have a lot of free time since I need to leave my job to take care of my mom with early signs of dementia.

So I started playing with ai just to kill time then I started a game project with godot for fun and now after a couple of months I feel it "playable" I know it need a lot of works and months burning tokens lol, I'm using as art the default robot of Godot but I now I want to see some characters y have in my mind but I'm struggling with it, can't find how to do it with a good consistent art, at least I want a hero then 3 or 4 enemies to test things.

I'm using claude pro + DeepSeek free, the game "skeleton" is near to be finished so what you guys use to generate those pretty nice pixel art I can see in all posts here.

comments.author: RsetX
comments.body: If you can run models locally you can try Stable Diffusion of Fooocus (I installed the last one asking Claude to do it for me). To animate the sprites you can use the free tool I created (yes, self promotion) it is a wrapper working with ComfiUI as back end: https://shaddafare.itch.io/sprite-sheep

replies.author: -Star-Walker-
replies.body:
Oh cool … you are using Minimax H3 for animation? I‘m just in the process of creating a proof of concept, and I need 4 animations. walk-sideways, walk-up, walk-down, idle  
Maybe you could share your prompts 🙃

replies.author: RsetX
replies.body: I don't have specific prompt for those actions, my tool have a Wizard Prompt to inject info correctly in the process
